user.title: Find a bus stop
user.description: Type part of the stop name, for example Mei Foo. Or paste a 16-character stop ID.

pick.title: Choose the stop
pick.description: Poles that share a name and only differ by a code such as FT920 and FT921 are combined into one device.

routes.title: Choose routes
routes.description:

Select one or more routes. Each becomes a sensor whose state is minutes until the next bus.
